description: The largest hackathon of Google Cloud - AI Builder Cup, powered by Hack2skill is now live. It is an open invitation to all the developers to build an AI solution on Google Cloud. The process is simple. You get a real-world problem, you get to form your team and a few weeks to build something that solves it and finally submit it for evaluation. The most potential solutions move on to an in-person finale happening in Singapore, where teams from across the JAPAC region come together to demo what they made, in front of a live panel of Google Cloud & industry experts.
